name: ui-input
description: Bootstrap form control: every input type, sizes, floating label, input group, adornments, plaintext, datalist, file, clearable, validation.

descriptions.--bs-control-action-bg: Background of the file input's button.
descriptions.--bs-control-action-hover-bg: Background of the file input's button on hover.
descriptions.--bs-control-transition-timing: Timing function of the focus transition.
descriptions.--bs-control-select-bg: Bootstrap's caret image (here the caret is an SVG in currentColor instead).
descriptions.--bs-control-select-bg-dark: Bootstrap's caret image in dark mode (unused here, see above).
descriptions.--bs-input-group-addon-padding-y: Input group: vertical padding of prefix/suffix texts.
descriptions.--bs-input-group-addon-padding-x: Input group: horizontal padding of prefix/suffix texts.
descriptions.--bs-input-group-addon-font-size: Input group: font size of prefix/suffix texts.
descriptions.--bs-input-group-addon-line-height: Input group: line height of prefix/suffix texts.
descriptions.--bs-input-group-addon-color: Input group: text colour of prefix/suffix texts.
descriptions.--bs-input-group-addon-bg: Input group: background of prefix/suffix texts.
descriptions.--bs-input-group-addon-border-color: Input group: border colour of prefix/suffix texts.
descriptions.--bs-form-floating-height: Floating label: height of the field.
descriptions.--bs-form-floating-input-padding-t: Floating label: top padding of the field (room for the label).
descriptions.--bs-form-floating-input-padding-b: Floating label: bottom padding of the field.
descriptions.--bs-form-floating-label-height: Floating label: height of the label.
descriptions.--bs-form-floating-label-bg: Floating label: background of the floated label (textareas).
descriptions.--bs-form-floating-label-disabled-bg: Floating label: that background while disabled.
descriptions.--bs-form-floating-label-opacity: Floating label: opacity of the floated label.
descriptions.--bs-form-floating-label-transform: Floating label: transform of the floated label.
descriptions.--bs-form-floating-transition-property: Floating label: properties animated when it floats.
descriptions.--bs-form-floating-transition-duration: Floating label: duration of that animation.
descriptions.--bs-form-floating-transition-timing: Floating label: timing function of that animation.
descriptions.--bs-form-adorn-gap: Adornments: space between icon/text and the value.
descriptions.--bs-form-adorn-icon-color: Adornments: colour of icons and texts.
descriptions.--bs-strength-height: Password strength: height of the meter.
descriptions.--bs-strength-gap: Password strength: space between the segments.
descriptions.--bs-strength-margin-top: Password strength: space above the meter and the message.
descriptions.--bs-strength-color: Password strength: colour of the current level (set by the level).
